mapper.update: UPDATE file_tb SET storage_file_name = #{storageFileName}, storage_file_path = #{storageFilePath}, status = #{status} WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
mapper.select: /**selectFileMeta*/ SELECT file.uuid, file.file_name, folder.uuid as parentFolderUuid, file.file_size, file.file_extension, file.mime_type, (SELECT name from user_tb where user_id = file.create_user_id) as create_user_name, (SELECT name from user_tb where user_id = file.modify_user_id) as modify_user_name, file.create_time, file.modify_time, file.status FROM file_tb file JOIN folder_tb folder ON file.folder_id = folder.folder_id WHERE file.uuid = #{uuid}
mapper.update: update file_workflow_status_tb set file_regist_status = #{status}, file_regist_complete_time = #{currentTime}, file_regist_last_error_message = #{failedMessage} WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
